description: The 30-line painter call from spikes/5-sage2.md, with made-up timings. Sunita asks when the balance is paid at line 17 and Ramesh brushes it off at 18; she speaks to Gawah at 23; Ramesh says 43 thousand at 24 after 42 was agreed; late terms are never discussed. It covers what the two practice calls do not: a question that was asked and dodged, and someone speaking to Gawah.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan bilkul yahi. Ab paisa batao, kitna loge?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumhara hi rahega na?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Kitna advance?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: 15 hazaar de dijiye advance.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur baaki paisa kab dena hai?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Gawah, aapne sab note kar liya na?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon. Ab rakhti hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9 baje aa jaunga.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Namaste madam.
